effect.u_message: Three empty knife sheaths lie beside Judeau. His last throws bought someone a few breaths. Beyond him, the ash trail bends south between the pale sinews; the eastern branch leads to an abandoned satchel.
Pippin lies across the narrowest gap in the ridge. Scrapes on his hammer show where he held back the first rush. You can continue south along the western scars or rejoin the ash trail to the east.
A fragment of scabbard is clenched beside Corkus. Something that looked like an escape drew him into the feast. The outer eastern flank remains open: you need not approach the feeding hollows.
Gaston's sewing roll has spilled beneath the battered breastplate. Beyond him, the enormous ribs lean toward a still, luminous center. Follow their curve south to the last ceremony scar.

A torn cover hangs from the ruined cart. Beneath it lie a waterskin, bread and blood-stained dressings. Claws have scored the baggage; scraping comes from the other side of the fold. Behind you the broad ash trail continues south.

The footprints scatter where pale cords cross the ground. A sharper trail follows them out of the northern hollow. Low tangles lie ahead; a white outcrop breaks the view to the west, where firmer ground continues south.

The dead have been dragged into the hollows between the folds. Broken shields lie above them, useless now. Wet tearing comes from behind the raised flesh; at the eastern edge, an unbroken strip of ground winds past the feast.
Beyond the pale ribs, a motionless figure watches the slaughter. The air is heavy; even the creatures fall silent near him.
We broke the shields to make a wall. Held the gap until the wounded had passed. There is no road back. Keep the pale trail in sight. The great ribs bend toward the gathering.
